items.editor_note: First head-to-head benchmark scoring Claude Code and Cursor against two other agents on the same task.

editorial.tldr: SonarQube extended its trusted-verification plugins to cover Claude Code, Copilot, Codex, and Cursor on Jul 1. A week later a Datadog engineer published a detailed account of pairing Claude and Cursor for a real production storage migration.
editorial.whats_new: MarkTechPost scored four coding agents — Mistral Vibe for Code, Claude Code, Cursor, and Codex — on the same scaffold-to-PR task on Jul 14, giving builders a like-for-like comparison instead of vendor benchmarks.
editorial.why_it_matters: Coding-agent choice is becoming an evaluable decision: cross-agent verification tooling and apples-to-apples task benchmarks now exist, so teams no longer have to take vendor performance claims on faith.
editorial.take_for_builders: Before standardizing on one coding agent, run the same scaffold-to-PR task through your shortlist yourself, and check whether your review tooling already verifies that agent's output rather than assuming vendor benchmarks transfer to your codebase.

status.detail: Coverage keeps pairing Claude Code and Cursor as both production tools and benchmark subjects rather than settling on one winner.
